bullets.bullet_text: Led CCAR-era capital, liquidity, stress testing, and model-validation work by structuring traceable scenarios, challenger variants, model-risk remediation, and governance evidence for regulated financial institutions.

Directed CCAR-era capital, liquidity, and stress-testing programs, structuring traceable scenarios, challenger models, and model-risk remediation to produce audit-ready governance evidence for regulators.
Architected enterprise risk-management operating models aligned to BCBS 239, defining three-lines-of-defense accountability, metadata standards, and auditable risk metrics across the organization.
